title: CodeGrind AI Assistant Expansion: New Azure OpenAI Integration
summary: Showcase the upgraded AI assistant with Azure OpenAI integration, real-time code guidance, and a refreshed problem-solving flow
core_message: CodeGrind now features enhanced AI-assisted problem solving powered by Azure OpenAI, offering multiple model support, persistent chat, and improved guidance within the LeetCode-style practice environment. This streamlines learning and accelerates debugging directly in the IDE.
cta: Try the new AI-assisted problem-solving flow in CodeGrind and share a quick performance highlight from your last solved challenge.
visual_brief: Static UI-focused image showing the CodeGrind editor with AI chat panel, highlighted problem statement, and code editor; include subtle cyberpunk aesthetic, Azure OpenAI branding softly inferred, and a caption-style overlay: 'AI Assistant enhanced with Azure OpenAI in CodeGrind'.
